# FG-CI-0003

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `cancelling_a_finished_pipeline_is_a_state_conflict` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このパイプラインは今の状態では取り消し・再実行ができません。画面を読み込み直してください。
- en: This pipeline cannot be cancelled or retried in its current state. Reload the page.
- id: Pipeline ini tidak dapat dibatalkan atau dijalankan ulang dalam keadaannya saat ini. Muat ulang halaman.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C2: `POST …/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/cancel` on a pipeline that is already finished (succeeded, failed, canceled, skipped, invalid, error), or `POST …/retry` on one that is not `failed` or `canceled` (running ones are cancelled first; `invalid` / `error` have no jobs to retry — push a fix or run a new pipeline). The state is read under the row's lock, so two people pressing at once get one change and one conflict. Not a fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `pipeline_id`, `project_id`, `operation` (`cancel` / `retry`) and `status` (the state found).

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to fix: reload the pipeline. To run again a pipeline that cannot be retried, start a new one (gstn pipeline run --project <id> --ref <branch>).
